workshop.abHint: On: only the excerpts of your document most similar to your question are sent. Off: the whole document is sent. Ask the same question both ways, with a new conversation in between, and compare the answers.
workshop.asSent: The text exactly as it is sent
workshop.attachDocWholeHint: Choose a file (text, Markdown, PDF, Word, PowerPoint or HTML). Your assistant will be given its whole text.
workshop.budgetCapped: Estimated ({tokenizer}). In this experiment the model may read only {cap} tokens; it could read {context}.
workshop.budgetEstimate: Estimated ({tokenizer}). The model reads {context} tokens; part is kept free for its answer.
workshop.candidatesTitle: What the search found in your document
workshop.capHint: An experiment: let the model read fewer tokens, and watch in the panel what the workshop leaves out to make room: first earlier tool results, then the end of your document, then the oldest messages. The model never sees what is left out.
workshop.chatEmpty: Send a message to test your assistant.
workshop.chatHint: Send a message to test your assistant, and watch what it receives in the panel.
workshop.comparisonEmpty: Run the same question in both modes to see the comparison.
workshop.comparisonMissing: Not run in this mode yet.
workshop.comparisonNoSources: The whole document was sent; nothing was searched (the search tool was removed too).
workshop.comparisonSameConversation: Both runs are in the same conversation: the second request also carried the first answer as an earlier message, so the comparison is not clean. Start a new conversation before asking again.
workshop.comparisonSourceCount: {count} excerpt(s) were placed in the prompt.
workshop.comparisonTitle: With and without the knowledge base
workshop.consent_declineHint: If you do not agree, close this page and tell your teacher.
workshop.consent_intro: This activity asks you to build a small AI assistant. Please read how your work is used before you continue.
workshop.consent_modelUnknown: Your teacher has not described the model yet. Ask before you continue if it matters to you.
workshop.consent_privacyBody: You can take part without uploading a personal document: any course material works. If you would rather not take part, tell your teacher instead of continuing.
workshop.consent_purposeBuild: You build an assistant: the instructions you write and the text of the document you attach are stored so your assistant can use them.
workshop.consent_purposeEvaluate: When you submit, your design, conversation and reflection are sent to the model to produce formative feedback. It is a suggestion: your teacher decides the grade.
workshop.consent_purposeHeading: What this activity does with your work
workshop.consent_purposeTest: You test it in a chat: your messages and the answers are stored with your activity, so you can review them and your teacher can see your progress.
workshop.consent_retentionDays: Your work is deleted automatically after {days} days without use. Your teacher can also delete it at any time.
workshop.consent_retentionManual: Your work is kept until your teacher deletes it.
workshop.consent_whereKb: So that it can be searched in step 3, the text of your document is also kept in the workshop’s knowledge base server, split into excerpts. It is deleted from there when you remove the document.
workshop.consent_whereLamb: Every message is sent to LAMB, the AI platform that runs the model. LAMB may record the beginning of each message in its technical logs.
workshop.consent_whereTool: This workshop tool stores your work on its own server.
workshop.cutLine: Only the {k} most similar go into the prompt
workshop.documentAttached: Its text is now part of what your assistant reads with every message.
workshop.documentPanelHint: The panel shows how much of what the model can read the document takes.
workshop.documentTruncated: Too long: only the first {kept} of {total} characters fit. The model never sees the rest.
workshop.documentWhole: The whole text is placed in the system message. The model can read about {limit} tokens per request.
workshop.dropHint: You can also drag and drop the file here.
workshop.engineMissing: The workshop is not connected to a model yet, so the chat cannot answer. Tell your teacher.
workshop.excerptsLater: Your document is not sent whole: when you send a message, the excerpts most similar to it are added before it.
workshop.feedbackTruncated: Some of this feedback may be incomplete — the model did not evaluate everything.
workshop.historyDropped: {count} of the oldest messages were left out to make room.
workshop.historyShare: Earlier messages are {percent}% of what is sent, and they grow with every message. Start a new conversation to clear them.
workshop.instructionHint: This text becomes the system message: the first thing your assistant reads.
workshop.instructionsExample: You are a helpful tutor that explains fractions step by step...
workshop.instructionsPlaceholder: Write what your assistant should do and how to answer...
workshop.kbConnect: Search my document instead of sending it whole
workshop.kbConnectHint: Your assistant then no longer receives the whole document: with every message, only the excerpts most similar to it are added before your question. In step 5 you can switch between the two.
workshop.kbFailed: Your document could not be prepared for searching. Remove it in step 2 and attach it again.
workshop.kbNoDocument: You have not attached a document in step 2, so there is nothing to search. Attach one there to try this step, or continue to the next step.
workshop.kbNotAvailable: This workshop has no knowledge base server, so this step is not available. You can continue to the next step.
workshop.kbProcessing: Preparing your document for searching: it is split into excerpts and each one is turned into numbers that capture its meaning (embeddings)…
workshop.kbReady: Your document “{name}” was split into {chunks} excerpts of up to {size} characters.
workshop.kbTestPlaceholder: What does my document say about…?
workshop.kbUnreachable: The knowledge base server cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
workshop.missingSession: Missing session. Open this activity from your course page.
workshop.modelError: The model service returned an error instead of an answer.
workshop.modelThinking: Sent. The model is thinking before it answers (its thinking is not passed on, only the answer)…
workshop.newConversationStarted: New conversation: the messages above are no longer sent to the model.
workshop.noRubric: No rubric is configured for this activity, so no feedback was generated.
workshop.panelEmpty: Nothing to observe yet — the panel fills in as you build.
workshop.previewPhase: What your next message would send
workshop.probeHitsTitle: Excerpts retrieved by this test question
workshop.probeNoHits: No excerpt matched this question. Try different words.
workshop.probePanelHint: see the panel for the excerpts and how similar they are.
workshop.ragOffBadge: Knowledge base off: the whole document
workshop.receiptHint: Show in the panel what your assistant received for this message
workshop.receiptToolCalls: {count, plural, one {# tool call} other {# tool calls}}
workshop.reenterFromCourse: Open the activity again from your course page to continue.
workshop.reflectionQ1: What did you ask your assistant to do, and why?
workshop.reflectionQ2: What did you see in the panels — what did the assistant actually receive?
workshop.reflectionQ3: What would you change in your design after testing it?
workshop.retrievalInfo: Split into chunks of {size} characters overlapping by {overlap} · embeddings: {model} · {ms} ms
workshop.rowHistory: {messages, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} · {turns, plural, one {# earlier turn} other {# earlier turns}}
workshop.rowRetrieval: {count, plural, one {# excerpt, added} other {# excerpts, added}} before your message
workshop.rowToolRounds: {count, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}} in this message
workshop.selectTools: Select tools your assistant can call
workshop.similarityHint: Similarity between the question and the excerpt: 1 is the same meaning, 0 unrelated, below 0 opposite
workshop.source_call: Tool call written by the model
workshop.source_history_call: Earlier tool call written by the model
workshop.source_history_result: Earlier tool result sent back by the workshop
workshop.source_result: Tool result sent back by the workshop
workshop.submitted: Submitted. You can still edit it and submit again.
workshop.teacherDecides: This is formative guidance, not a grade. Your teacher decides the final score.
workshop.teacherTrial: You are trying the workshop as a teacher. Your work is kept apart from the students’.
workshop.title: AI Workshop
workshop.toolMalformed: The model began a tool call but did not follow the format, so its text was taken as the answer.
workshop.toolResultsElided: {count} earlier tool results were replaced by a short note to make room.
workshop.toolsAsTextHint: A tool is described to the model in words. When the model wants to use it, it writes a call as text; the workshop runs it and sends back the result.
workshop.toolsTextEmpty: No tools: the assistant can only answer with text.
